newTelemetryOnly: Three ArrayPool delegate wrappers and selection/scalar loan/rent-allocation counters, including gated rootless calls.
rentAllocationBoundary: GC.GetAllocatedBytesForCurrentThread immediately before inner.Rent and immediately after its normal return; no recorder action inside measured boundary.
returnSemantics: Always inner.Return(array, clearArray), original arguments unchanged; no array history/strong loan retention.
outstandingLoanScope: Current outstanding emitted at every successful gated Rent; max is actual collection peak. Separate all-time peak is labeled.
selectionScope: Original Current/IsOpen evaluated once at original selection point.
rootlessPoolCoverage: Gated no-coarse pool events anchor0 and flush at next coarse close; fixedlabels/numeric facts only.
cpuOverride: DOTNET_PROCESSOR_COUNT explicitly unset; no ThreadPool/GC tuning.
observer: No external observer; previous auxiliary JSON-read race remains separately retained. Built-in resource samples reused.
releaseBinding: Reused binding.core anchors distinguish release-core from acquisitions.
